premise: Little Fish counts his friends in the rock pool and only gets to three, worried someone is missing, until Clam asks who is doing the counting.
inspiration: The folk tale of the counters who forget themselves (the six travellers who count only five), told as a giggle: the missing one is the counter.

en-US.title: Counting in the Pool
en-US.text: [playfully] {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Little Fish was counting his friends. {fish:face happy} One… {clam:enter} {clam:pulse} Clam, at the bottom, quiet as a pebble. Two… {urchin:enter} {urchin:pulse} Urchin, round and purple and wiggly. Three… {shrimp:enter} {shrimp:pulse} Shrimp, pink and quick, zipping about. {fish:face sad} [nervously] Three? But there were four of us this morning! He counted again. One, two, three. {fish:shake} [sad] Oh no. One of us is missing! {urchin:live} Urchin wiggled his spines. {shrimp:face happy} Shrimp giggled. {clam:live} Clam opened up, and closed again. [playfully] Little Fish, she said, who's doing the counting? {fish:face surprised} Me! said Little Fish… and then he understood. [laughs] FOUR! I forgot to count ME! {fish:live} He wiggled his tail and fluttered his fins. {urchin:face happy} {clam:face happy} {shrimp:hearts} One, two, three… and four. Everyone was right where they should be.

es-ES.title: Contando en la charca
es-ES.text: [playfully] {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Pececito estaba contando a sus amigos. {fish:face happy} Uno… {clam:enter} {clam:pulse} Almeja, en el fondo, callada como una piedra. Dos… {urchin:enter} {urchin:pulse} Erizo, redondo, morado y meneón. Tres… {shrimp:enter} {shrimp:pulse} Gamba, rosa y rapidísima, de aquí para allá. {fish:face sad} [nervously] ¿Tres? ¡Pero esta mañana éramos cuatro! Volvió a contar. Uno, dos, tres. {fish:shake} [sad] ¡Ay, no! ¡Falta uno! {urchin:live} Erizo meneó sus pinchos. {shrimp:face happy} Gamba se rió. {clam:live} Almeja se abrió, y se volvió a cerrar. [playfully] Pececito, dijo, ¿quién está contando? {fish:face surprised} ¡Yo!, dijo Pececito… y entonces lo entendió. [laughs] ¡CUATRO! ¡Se me olvidó contarME! {fish:live} Meneó la cola y agitó las aletas. {urchin:face happy} {clam:face happy} {shrimp:hearts} Uno, dos, tres… y cuatro. Todos estaban justo donde tenían que estar.
